name: EPIC 212095972
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 8.8 solar radii and 0.99 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212095972 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.786858 (16th-84th percentiles 8.42207-9.185774), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212095972 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.986729 (16th-84th percentiles 0.890144-1.09776), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212095972: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4697.378 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212095972 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3389.414062 (16th-84th percentiles 3267.109375-3516.484375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.08 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,389 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.99 solar masses and 8.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,697 K at its surface.
